summary: 15/15 API regression tests passed. Browser-tested earnings/cancellation, profile-only simulator, dashboard payout/interests, insight contribution-to-publication, rewards shipping/boost, studio CRUD/review, admin shortcuts and CSV analytics. All 8 routes fit 1920x800, 390x844 and 360x780. Two confirmed earnings display defects remain; no blocking workflow failure or API 500 observed. All ads, AI, money, shipping and analytics are intentionally SIMULATED/MOCKED.

ui_bugs.issue: After withdrawing to zero, landing and simulator vault display $14.850 although dashboard/nav/simulator summary correctly show zero. Root cause: balance_mills || 14850 treats legitimate zero as missing (line 26). Use nullish fallback.

Boost credits are saved correctly but earned indicator and success toast omit bonus. With boost active, two charges increased actual balance $0.000 -> $0.011 -> $0.023; indicator showed +$0.022 instead of +$0.023, and toast remains +$0.011. Root cause: hardcoded setEarned(e=>e+11) and toast in line 16 instead of actual server balance delta.

issues: Repeated Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) mount warnings from ResponsiveContainer. Charts ultimately render, but initial container sizing should be stabilized.
.insight-mini radius is 9px, exceeding requested <=8px card limit; AdBox12px is the explicit exception.

action_items: Replace falsy balance fallback with nullish fallback; verify zero in both landing and simulator.
Use actual credited delta for earned indicator and toast, including boost remainder payouts.
Stabilize chart container initial sizes and lower insight-mini radius to 8px.
Manually check discovered-interest reset in a disposable session; reset actions were excluded per testing safety instructions.
critical_code_review_comments: Potential concurrent read idempotency race: insight_action checks reads in previously fetched session but Mongo update filter contains only token; concurrent requests can both increment discovered while $addToSet deduplicates reads. 12-way HTTP test passed this run, so this is a code-review risk, not a reproduced defect. Add reads-not-containing-id to atomic write predicate.

InterestRadar fixes axes to six declared topics, excluding Systems, Math and Startups. Default discovered Systems44 and subsequent reads of those topics cannot appear on radar; consider supporting union of declared/discovered topics.

Campaign.topics accepts arbitrary strings and whitespace-only creative text passes backend length validation, despite stricter frontend checks. Consider server-side target whitelist and stripped nonblank validation. Not exercised as failures this iteration.

success_rate.frontend: 24/24 responsive route checks passed; core workflows passed after animation waits; 2 confirmed display defects

test_credentials: Credentials file contains only placeholder comments. No account credentials are needed; isolated demo sessions were created via /api/session. External URL used from frontend/.env, not the older briefing URL.
seed_data_creation: No seed/reset/migration run and no pre-existing user data changed. API fixtures cleaned their exact tokens/owner records. Two tracked browser sandboxes are cleaned using exact tokens; campaign/submission titles were TEST_ prefixed. Initial anonymous smoke session was not tracked, so its default simulation profile may remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No application source modified. API pytest runs via backend pytest.ini xdist configuration and uses frontend env URL. Drawer forced clicks initially failed during 500ms slide animation, then passed with 600ms wait; these were test timing errors, not app defects. Initial selector send-prompt was corrected to send-prompt-button. Screenshot route-name expression caused a tool wrapper TypeError and was corrected with explicit names. Source href was verified; third-party doc navigation was not exercised. Concurrent read test passed once; boost $30 cap was reviewed but not exhausted via thousands of views. No real AI/ad/payment/shipment integration exists by design. No broken visible images, page error text, horizontal overflow or blocking console errors observed; only Recharts warnings.
